It maintained its market leadership in India throughout–reflecting the Company’s obsession with creating customer delight and demonstrating its agility to adapt to the changing times. This was possible by leveraging the unique ability of Suzuki Motor Corporation (parent company) to design feature-rich, safer, environment-friendly products, delivering world-class quality at an affordable price. In FY 2023-24, Maruti Suzuki embarked on an ambitious path in terms of manufacturing scale, while simultaneously transiting towards a low-carbon path. This marks a new phase for the Company.
